title: Jazzy American Rice Bowl
description: A garlicky, gooey rice bowl packed with ginger, a mirepoix base, and fresh veggies—perfect for a sick day, all low FODMAP and packed in a bento box.
instructions: Rinse 1 cup of rice under cold water until clear, then steam or cook according to package until fluffy.
Heat 1 tsp of sesame oil in a skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add minced garlic and ginger to the skillet and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Toss in diced carrot, celery, and white part of green onion, cooking for 3 minutes until slightly softened.
Stir in the cubed tofu and cook until lightly browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Pour in low FODMAP soy sauce and rice vinegar, stirring to coat the vegetables and tofu.
Add fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Fold in the cooked rice, mixing gently to combine all flavors.
Transfer the mixture into a bento box, arranging a few extra white onions and a sprinkle of chili flakes on top.
Serve warm, or let cool to enjoy at room temperature.
